items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: Glen Campbellesque, yeah I know. I was trying to write that way.

ctx.x: I love this, it’s got a certain Americana.

Glen Campbellesque, yeah I know. I was trying to write that way. I was trying to write like — I don’t know what you call it, we call it country & western or whatever. This was the middle 60s and you know I was starting to write songs and I figured I might as well try to write for the market. And this was the market part of it. The publisher actually said to me, “I like these, these are nice songs and everything and they’re very funny and very nice, but you know, why don’t you go home and write some…
